title: CaviarNine LSU Pool (Radix) - stale-valuation sandwich via public price refresh
closed_reasons: no free-withdrawal path: all value sits behind add/remove_liquidity share accounting or owner roles
swap path prices both legs at fresh validator redemption values and charges fees (no leak)
no negative stale gaps exist (all 82 cached prices <= fresh), so the reverse sandwich is unprofitable
credit receipts cannot be forged or inflated (NFT data updates restricted to global_caller(component))

tests: preview: update_multiple_validator_prices(200) x2 adds +156,700.779 XRD to dex_valuation_xrd (permissionless refresh) - PASS (local); CI single-call delta +157,492.272 XRD - PASS

preview: atomic stake -> add_liquidity -> public refresh -> remove_liquidity on live mainnet with real funding account nets +1,219.501 LSU (~+1,495.75 XRD net of 5.384 XRD fee, ~$0.4543; 1.28M XRD capital) - PASS local; CI with 1.0M XRD capital nets +957.059 LSU (+1,172.71 XRD net, ~$0.3562) - PASS

key_facts: Recorded dex_valuation_xrd 119,627,574.224120164155823961 XRD vs fresh value 119,784,293.063 XRD -> stale gap C = 156,718.84 XRD (0.1308%) at state version 563,204,896; measured refresh delta +156,700.78 XRD
C in USD at DefiLlama coingecko:radix 0.0003037594191718614 (2026-10-14) = $47.60; pool TVL fresh ~= $36.4K
Extraction formula profit_XRD = C * D/(V+D) - fees: max $47.60 (D->inf), ~$23.8 at D=V, ~$43.3 at D=10V
Demonstrated end-to-end with 1,280,000 XRD (~$389) capital: net +1,495.75 XRD (~$0.4543) in ONE atomic preview transaction; status Succeeded; 88.76M cost units; tx fee 5.384 XRD
update_multiple_validator_prices is PUBLIC (deployed interface + role assignments confirm); add_liquidity/swap require the allow-all 'user' role; remove_liquidity is PUBLIC
Pool holds 82 LSU resources; LSULP supply 97,447,941.266766377338962701; credit receipt NFTs 2,034; fees 1bp protocol / 5bp liquidity / 1bp reserve; no pause mechanism

Reserve vaults hold 141,678.09 XRD fresh (~$43.04), owner-badge-only (badge resource_rdx1nglan7djf0stpdm5pf3hzctlha366l3s5xllu9z04z6puctdg200m4, 3 NFTs minted, holders not enumerable via public Gateway)
Token validator component_rdx1cz7h8j68esue87jmq4fqpnx5403jujadewlqcn5cqxew80fwd5fgd has require_active=true (gates deposits of inactive-validator LSUs only)
Off-chain price check: stake_xrd_vault/lsu_supply equals the contract get_validator_price_lsu_xrd for all 82 resources (0 mismatches); sum(main vault * cached price) == dex_valuation_xrd to 1e-13
CaviarNine is sunsetting; price-refresh activity is sparse (5 prices per pool operation + any public refresh), so the gap persists and re-accrues ~32K XRD (~$9.7)/day

Deployed-vs-repo deviation observed on-chain in the credit-discount fee path: taxable=(payout-credit)/(1-liquidity_fee) and the 5bp liquidity fee is not deducted from the user payout (tiny, does not affect extraction math)
caveats: C and USD are point-in-time (state version 563,204,896 / epoch 349494, 2026-10-14); both drift with rewards and pool activity
The $47.60 headline is the theoretical stale-gap bound requiring capital >> pool TVL; the demonstrated net extraction with $389 capital is $0.4543; a capital-constrained attacker captures C*D/(V+D)
Preview simulations used a real live account only as a simulated funding source (assume_all_signature_proofs, use_free_credit); nothing was signed or submitted
Deployed bytecode source is not verified through the Gateway; behaviour verified in simulation; minor fee-formula deviation from the public repo documented
Gateway stream/transactions affected_global_entities filter proved unreliable in testing and was not used for any claim
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract up to ~$47.60 live (stale-valuation gap C=156,718.84 XRD) from CaviarNine LSU Pool by depositing LSU at the stale pool valuation, calling the PUBLIC update_multiple_validator_prices refresh, and redeeming at the refreshed valuation; demonstrated end-to-end net +$0.4543 on $389 capital in one atomic transaction.
